name: Henry AI
tagline: Your company's AI employee for every department.
description: Henry is one AI employee your whole company shares. It works inside your tools, remembers your team's decisions, and runs recurring work on schedule across Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Support. Teams can reach it in the web app, Slack, Microsoft Teams, iMessage/SMS, or mobile. It connects to over 3,200 apps, including Gmail, HubSpot, Notion, and Linear. Anything that sends, books, or spends waits for your approval.
